name: Glioma and brain-tumor lesion characterization
target_definition: Brain tumor lesion regions and glioma characterization (grade, subtype, or prognostic features) on multiparametric MRI, referenced against pathological confirmation and expert neuroradiologist annotation.
population: Patients with pathologically confirmed brain tumors or suspected gliomas, evaluated by multiparametric MRI including T1, T1-contrast, T2, and FLAIR sequences.
expected_output: Tumor region segmentation, glioma characterization (grade or subtype), and prognostic risk estimates where supported.

reference_datasets.label: BraTS dataset
reference_datasets.citation: Brain Tumor Segmentation Challenge, University of Pennsylvania

limitations: Segmentation and characterization do not constitute a diagnosis or treatment recommendation.
BraTS and TCGA datasets primarily contain known tumor cases; prevalence and generalization to screening populations is not established.
Grade and subtype classification depend on availability of pathology; imaging-only prediction of grade is inherently limited.
Multiparametric MRI acquisition protocols vary; models trained on a specific protocol may not generalize to different scanner parameters.
